nom: Peter Thomas Roth Collagen Skinjection Plumping & Firming Serum

segments.dry: Dry-skin reviewers report increased hydration, reduced dry patches, and a plumper, more comfortable feel, including one recovering from severe winter dryness.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers generally report no irritation or redness and note the serum is fragrance-free and gentle, though one sensitive/dry/acne-prone reviewer had no negative reaction at all while another combination reaction was mixed.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers describe the serum as hydrating and well-tolerated, absorbing without heaviness.
segments.oily: One reviewer with combination/oily skin says the formula works for her, while another separate reviewer notes it can feel slightly oily on the skin during the day.
segments.mature: Mature-skin reviewers report subtle firming, fuller-looking cheeks and laugh lines, reduced fine lines, and improved elasticity with continued use.
segments.normal: A reviewer whose skin is normally normal/combination but was temporarily very dry reports the serum restored plumpness and reduced dry patches.

concerns.aging: Most reviewers citing fine lines, wrinkles, elasticity, or firmness report visible plumping, subtle reduction in fine lines, and improved elasticity within one to three weeks; one reviewer says wrinkles are still visible and needs more time to judge results.
concerns.dehydration: The large majority of reviewers describe an immediate hydration boost, plumper and softer skin, and relief from winter dryness, with no dissenting reports of the serum failing to hydrate.
concerns.redness: The few reviewers who mention redness say the serum leaves none and causes no irritation after use.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers describing barrier or resilience concerns report the serum strengthens skin, improves healing, and restores elasticity over daily use.
concerns.spots: Not enough reviewers specifically discuss spots or hyperpigmentation to characterize this concern.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers report no new breakouts and even clearer-looking skin, but two reviewers explicitly report breakouts or burning after use, including one one-star report of a bad reaction.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer with oily/combination skin found it worked well for her skin type, while a separate reviewer noted the serum can feel slightly oily on the skin during the day.

aspects.libelle: Layers well under moisturizer and makeup
Slight oily feel during the day
Breakouts or burning reaction on application

extraits.texte: This product was received complimentary from peterthomasroth and is my honest opinion. I would not purchase this for myself. It made me break out and burned really bad. Something was messed up with it.

Complimentary from Peter Thomas Roth, for my honest thoughts. I have been applying this to my face first, before any other product. The serum is so light, slightly feeling gel like. My face feels super smooth! After using a few days, I did break out a bit. I'm still using it, since I do feel it's doing something. My face is feeling firmer. I can still see my wrinkles, but I think that just needs more time for the product to give results. My skin still has a long ways to go, but I definitely like the way it feels. I do love the glass packaging.

I've been using the Collagen Skinjection Plumping & Firming Skin Barrier Serum for a few weeks now, and I'm honestly impressed with the results. My skin tends to be on the dry and slightly sensitive side, so I'm always cautious when trying new products—but this one has been a great addition to my routine. complimentary from Peter Thomas Roth

I have very sensitive, dry, and acne prone skin that often looks dull. I'm 30 and had yet to try a collagen product before this one. I was super excited to try because I love the Peter Thomas Roth brand. I incorporated the serum into my night time routine and WOW I am so impressed! It's super lightweight and goes on nicely. Best of all, I wake up in the morning with my skin looking radiant, glowy, and smooth! I'm so glad I got to try this and can't wait to see the long term results! Gifted by peterthomasroth.

I have been struggling with extra dry skin recently, something that is new to me, as I've always had norm/combo skin. This product helps to make my skin look and feel more plump and hydrated! I notice immediate results, but also over the past week, I've noticed less dry patches. I received this product complimentary from Peter Thomas Roth in exchange for my honest review.

I've implemented Peter Thomas Roth COLLAGEN SKINJECTION PLUMPING & FIRMING SERUM as part of my daily skin routine and have noticed a difference in the fullness and plumpness of my skin. I only add one droplet full and use my fingers to distribute evenly on my skin. Gifted by PeterThomasRoth

This felt really great on my skin! I think that the serum is good to use once or twice a day depending on your tolerance. I have combination and oily skin so I appreciate that this works for my skin! complimentary from peterthomasroth
